title: Mots en jeu(x) – expériences, réflexions et découvertes
bookshelves: Category: Reference, Information and Interdisciplinary subjects
summary: This volume showcases the multiple dimensions of wordplay in contemporary Francophone contexts by bringing academic approaches into dialog with practical reflections and experiences. The authors explore the various possibilities offered by words and language, highlighting the significance of wordplay across diverse fields, for various groups of people, and in a range of different usage contexts. Wordplay emerges both as a shared cultural resource and as a medium through which a great variety of topics and issues can be articulated.
